subject: Rework plan: BrightWorks exec standby + fallback runbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWorks demo — potential exec travel conflict and standby plan

Team — quick heads-up. BrightWorks is asking for a VP-level sightline on our walkthrough next week (they signaled that CFO/VP of Product would sit in for some parts). Meanwhile Daniel (their CTO) flagged travel that might land him mid-demo (tight layover). We need a concrete plan we can propose that preserves the timeline for the sales cadence but also guarantees exec coverage.

Options I want us to be ready to offer:
- Option A: Keep current slot (Mon 15th 10am PT). Start with the product deep-dive (45m) then have a 15m exec summary where VP/CTO join live — if CTO is delayed, we switch to conference bridge + recorded 10min CTO summary.
- Option B: Move to a 60m split session: 35m product deep-dive, 25m executive Q&A (CTO required). Pro: gives execs time; Con: pushes decision timeline by ~1 day.
- Option C: Keep slot but schedule a 30-min follow-up within 48 hours reserved for execs only (we reserve a tentative 11am PT slot as backup).

Action items: Marissa — please surface which execs BrightWorks expects to join and their preferred time zones. Rishi — please confirm internal backup (who covers CTO-level talking points if Daniel misses). Mina — can you draft a concise runbook describing the failover (scripts + who to call) and attach to the customer-facing note?

I want a short customer note we can send by EOD Wednesday with options + calendar placeholders. Keep it tight.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWorks demo — potential exec travel conflict and standby plan

Adding what I learned from the BrightWorks AE standup: Elena (BrightWorks) said they expect VP of Product (Sofia) + Daniel (CTO) to attend. Sofia is flexible earlier in the day; Daniel is crossing time zones and has a outbound flight that arrives 11:30am PT on the 15th.

Their preference is to avoid pushing the demo unless exec availability is the blocker for a commercial decision. They asked for a short list of fallback approaches — they like the idea of a reserved follow-up rather than moving the main slot.

I'll draft the customer options email and include a tentative 11am follow-up slot as Option C.

—Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWorks demo — potential exec travel conflict and standby plan

Confirmed internal backup: I can cover the executive summary if Daniel can't join. Quick bullets I can take:
- One-slide summary of TCO impact (quantified)
- Three risk areas + mitigation (security, latency, cost predictability)
- Live Q&A handling notes for when a CTO-level technical question comes up

Mina — if you can produce a 1-page runbook with a checklist (who dials, which deck slide to use, where to pull the latency dashboard) I can rehearse it with you tomorrow.

Also, can we prep a short recorded 8–10 minute CTO summary (Daniel-style) that we can drop in if needed? I can record if Daniel is not available.

—Rishi
Account Director
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightWorks demo — potential exec travel conflict and standby plan

Attached is a draft runbook (exec-coverage-runbook.md) and a slightly revised agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf). Key sections in the runbook:
- Pre-call prep (confirm dial-in + slide deck version)
- Live failover steps: (1) signal in chat that CTO is delayed; (2) Rishi takes exec segment; (3) record the final 10m CTO summary step; (4) secure follow-up 30-min slot and calendar hold (11:00am PT 15 Jun)
- Contact matrix (Elena: +1 415-555-0123, BrightWorks ops)
- Recording & artifacts: where to upload the short CTO recording + how to flag the recording in HubSpot (HS-Contact-4321)

I left an internal-only checklist at the bottom for who has deck nav control, who's sharing screens and dashboard links.

I'll inline the runbook into the customer note but keep the internal checklist private.

—Mina
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: exec-coverage-runbook.md)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightworks.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick confirmation and options for Monday's BrightWorks demo (15 Jun)

Elena / Daniel — thanks again for the quick sync earlier. To make the session as productive as possible without requiring a full schedule change, we have three practical options for Monday 15 Jun. Please let us know which you prefer by EOD Friday so we can lock calendar items: 

Option 1 — Proceed as scheduled (Mon 15 Jun, 10:00am PT): 60m live session. Start with product deep-dive (45m) followed by a 15m exec summary. If Daniel's flight arrives after the start, we will: (a) run the deep-dive as planned, then (b) either bring Daniel into the 15m exec summary if he's joined, or (c) Rishi (internal) will conduct the exec Q&A and we'll provide a short 8–10 minute recorded CTO summary within 24 hours.

Option 2 — Split session (two parts, reserve 10:00am–11:00am PT for product and a second 30–45m exec Q&A the next day if needed).

Option 3 — Hold current slot and reserve a 30-min follow-up at 11:00am PT on Mon 15 Jun as a tentative backup specifically for execs. We'll only finalize the follow-up if execs request it.

Attachments: demo-agenda-v2.pdf — updated agenda; exec-coverage-runbook.md — internal runbook (we'll keep the internal checklist private).

Proposed next step: reply with preferred option and any required exec time windows (Sofia/Daniel). If none selected, we'll proceed with Option 1 and prepare the recording fallback.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: demo-agenda-v2.pdf)
